space.name: Kitting Domain Layout 7
space.notes: Mid-run stay fixture with a REAL coffee machine (scenario_70 / _71, F47b; for D2's evaluation). The robot's route from the kitting table T (0, 50) to its first shelf, shelf_1 (0, -750), runs straight south along x = 0. coffee_machine_0 stands ON that route at (0, -550), with the human's shelf_5 (item_5) 100 cm west of it, beside the machine - the natural configuration, not tuned for the recognizer. The human walks in from the east along the aisle y = -550, takes its coffee break at the machine (the schema's PT60S), then delivers item_5 from the shelf beside it and finally switches on the AC by the east wall (ac_switch_0) and stays there. Every scheduled task is well typed (F47b). Two alternative shelves for the robot at the SAME 900 cm from T: shelf_2 beside the blocked shelf (45 deg west of its bearing) and shelf_3 across the table; only the robot's pool differs between the two scenarios. No obstacles.
